description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' that provides logging functions for the Android platform, acting as a wrapper for android.util.Log. It includes static methods for various log levels, manages a linked list of LogNode instances for custom logging, and defines log level constants.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate logging in Android, supporting log level constants, method chaining with LogNode, and utility methods for different log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode for log message propagation.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level; overloads allow with or without Throwable.
